content: Socorro is Mozilla-only (maintainers decline external support) with collector/processor/webapp on AWS S3+SQS+Elasticsearch; crash reports contain PII (URLs, emails, minidumps) with protected-data access groups; alternatives for forks: mini-breakpad-server, sentry_breakpad, Backtrace, BugSplat; crash pings via Telemetry are PII-free but need telemetry infra.
